requirements.quote: The Owner publishes PUE per cooling technique and the energy price during dialogue, for total cost of ownership
requirements.text: Owner provides PUE and energy price for cost analysis.

requirements.quote: The Contractor shall deliver a service substation that lands the utility lines above 100 kV and steps them down through HV-to-13.8 kV transformers to the site MV backbone
requirements.text: Contractor must provide a substation for utility connection and voltage transformation.

requirements.quote: The substation shall provide two MV buses so that core network and mechanical loads and GPU compute loads take separate paths
requirements.text: Substation must have two MV buses for load separation.

requirements.quote: On-site generation, if used, and energy storage shall connect to the MV bus, making the substation the integration point for flexible power and grid services
requirements.text: On-site generation and storage must connect to MV bus for integration.

requirements.quote: MV switchgear shall be 15 kV-class metal-clad with arc-rated construction (Type 2B), draw-out breakers, protective relays, instrument transformers, a control power transformer and battery-backed DC control power, housed in a walk-in enclosure with 2-hour fire-rated walls
requirements.text: MV switchgear must meet specified construction and safety standards.

requirements.quote: Main and feeder ratings shall be stated by the bidder from the Owner's load schedule. As a size reference, one public lineup uses a 2,000 A main, four 1,200 A feeders and five 1,200 A transfer bus switches
requirements.text: Bidder must specify main and feeder ratings based on load schedule.

requirements.quote: Bidders shall state the switchgear short-circuit rating in kA for 1 s, subject to calculation
requirements.text: Bidder must provide switchgear short-circuit rating.

requirements.quote: The campus shall take dual concurrently maintainable MV feeds, run below ground on diverse paths with concrete encasement
requirements.text: Campus must have dual maintainable MV feeds underground.

requirements.quote: MV control power shall be 110 VDC backed by a battery unit
requirements.text: MV control power must be 110 VDC with battery backup.

requirements.quote: Relays shall support communications and event recording, with a relay acting as a remote terminal unit where the Owner specifies
requirements.text: Relays must support communication and event recording.

requirements.quote: Backup generation shall be proposed by the bidder. The reference arrangement is central standby generators in N+2 at the MV switchgear, supporting 99.999% for critical core network and mechanical loads. An alternative is prefabricated generators in distributed redundancy. Fuel autonomy shall meet Tier III intent under EN 50600 Class 3
requirements.text: Bidder must propose backup generation meeting specified standards.

requirements.quote: The Contractor shall support the Owner's interconnection studies and supply protection-coordination data for the serving utility
requirements.text: Contractor must assist with interconnection studies and data.

requirements.quote: The Contractor shall supply power blocks that convert MV AC to 800 VDC. Transformer-rectifier units and solid-state transformers are both accepted
requirements.text: Contractor must provide power blocks for MV AC to 800 VDC conversion.

requirements.quote: Each block shall deliver 4.8 to 5 MW at the DC output from an input of 13.8 kVac ±10%, three-phase three-wire plus PE
requirements.text: Power blocks must deliver specified output from MV AC input.

requirements.quote: Input frequency shall be 57 to 63 Hz with a rate of change up to 5 Hz/s. Power factor shall exceed 0.99 at full load, 0.98 from 20% load and 0.95 below 20%
requirements.text: Input frequency and power factor must meet specified ranges.

requirements.quote: Harmonics shall meet IEEE 519, IEC 61800-3 Category C4, and IEC 61000-6-2 and -6-4
requirements.text: Harmonics must comply with specified standards.

requirements.quote: Short-circuit withstand shall be 18 to 40 kA symmetrical at 13.8 kV, with duration stated by the bidder, and the basic impulse level shall be at least 110 kV
requirements.text: Short-circuit withstand and impulse level must meet specifications.

requirements.quote: MV system grounding is low-resistance or solid, as set by the utility design
requirements.text: MV system grounding must follow utility design specifications.

requirements.quote: Blocks shall suit load acceptance and rejection of about 20 to 50 MW/min on utility supply
requirements.text: Blocks must handle specified load acceptance and rejection rates.

requirements.quote: Voltage ride-through: full output at 0.9 to 1.2 pu. In the first low-voltage range the block draws no more than nominal input current while supplying 100% of load. In the second it draws none, and storage carries 100% of load. Operation restores without state changes. Frequency ride-through is continuous at 58.8 to 61.2 Hz and lasts 299 s at 57.0 to 58.8 Hz and 61.2 to 61.8 Hz
requirements.text: Voltage and frequency ride-through must meet specified ranges and durations.

requirements.quote: Output shall be 800 VDC nominal, unipolar, with ripple ±0.5%, static regulation ±1% and dynamic regulation
requirements.text: Output must meet specified voltage and regulation standards.
